semantics.clock: All state changes occur on positive clk edges, as explicitly specified.
semantics.reset: Active high synchronous reset has priority and sets q to 32'h1 on a positive edge.
semantics.transition: Shift right; old q[0] feeds back into one-based tap positions 32,22,2,1 (zero-based q[31],q[21],q[1],q[0]). q[31] receives feedback; other tapped positions receive shifted source XOR feedback.
semantics.initialization: No power-up value is specified; no initial assignment is implemented. Verification establishes a known state through synchronous reset.
semantics.latency: Each positive edge performs exactly one transition or reset. Output holds between positive edges.

numeric.arithmetic: Bitwise XOR, unsigned logical right shift

verification.oracle: Independent per-bit next-state model derived from original right shift and one-based taps
cases: Output holds on falling edges and reset changes without rising edges
verification.sampling: Sample one time unit after positive edge for nonblocking updates
verification.failure: $fatal on mismatch with bounded timeout; PASS only after all checks

specification_ambiguities: Tap positions are expressed one-based (32 denotes the MSB); map them to zero-based output indices 31,21,1,0.
Power-up state is unspecified; no defined pre-reset numeric value is required.
